original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚翁多州警方突袭假美元工厂，查获三袋假钞
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚翁多州警方在Odigbo地方政府区Kiniso村突袭一处疑似假币生产窝点，逮捕一名嫌疑人并查获三袋疑似假美元。警方称此次行动于10月29日进行，源于一名男子投诉在换汇交易中收到假美元。目前案件仅有一个来源报道，相关指控尚未经独立核实。

location.site: Kiniso Village, via Ajue, Odigbo LGA

key_facts.fact: 翁多州警方在Odigbo地方政府区发现一处疑似假币生产窝点
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Ondo State Police Command has uncovered a suspected counterfeit currency production site in Odigbo Local Government Area of the state

key_facts.fact: 警方逮捕一名嫌疑人并查获三袋疑似假美元
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: arresting one suspect and recovering three bags of suspected fake United States dollar notes
the operation took place on October 29 at Kiniso Village, via Ajue

key_facts.fact: 案件源于一名男子投诉在换汇中收到假美元
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: following investigations into a complaint by a man who allegedly received counterfeit dollars from two men during a currency exchange transaction
